title: Tough Cookie
overview: When a hard boiled young woman from one of the toughest neighborhoods in her city recognizes a teenage mother that’s been falling in with a dangerous group of girls from her hood, she tries to remain indifferent, only to find out that she, herself, is in danger of losing custody of her own child. Realizing how limited her options are, she decides to stop the young girl from making the same mistakes she did, in the only way she knows how.
